kpis.label: Active FSD subscriptions
kpis.detail: Up 67% on a year earlier (1.04M in Q3 2025). Tesla's footnote: the count includes upfront payments and monthly subscriptions and excludes free trials.

kpis.label: North America attach rate
kpis.detail: Share of new vehicle deliveries in North America that include FSD (Supervised), Q3 2026. Tesla calls it a nearly twenty percentage point rise on the quarter before.

kpis.label: Europe: customers using FSD
kpis.detail: Tesla says over 100,000 customers in nine EU countries have logged more than 160 million kilometres since each country's approval.

adoption.title: Active FSD subscriptions by quarter
adoption.caveat: The ratio is our own calculation: active subscriptions divided by all Teslas ever delivered. Older cars leave the fleet and some owners use FSD on a car they bought secondhand, so it is a proxy for take rate, not a figure Tesla reports.

changes.text: Page created. Adoption figures are taken from Tesla's Q1, Q2 and Q3 2026 shareholder decks; countries come from our global FSD tracker data.
